podcast.title: The Planning Desk
podcast.description: Supply chain planning and design news with a focus on the Nordics and the DACH region: a quick briefing every weekday morning, a book worth your time every Saturday and a fifteen-minute week in review every Sunday. Disruptions, trade and macro signals, planning technology and AI, real company use cases, the events worth your time and the books behind good planning.
podcast.ai_disclosure: The Planning Desk is produced with AI. AI agents gather and summarise news and books from public sources, and the hosts' voices are synthetic.
podcast.author: The Planning Desk

N.note: Saturday book narrator. Anna (F) opens and closes the book episode.

jingles.intro_prompt: Up-tempo rock intro for a news podcast, 10 seconds, instrumental, around 150 BPM. Driving overdriven electric guitar riff, punchy live drums with a big snare, tight bass. Energetic and confident, builds fast and hits a clean final power chord on the last beat.
jingles.outro_prompt: Up-tempo rock outro for a news podcast, 10 seconds, instrumental, around 150 BPM, same band sound as the intro: overdriven electric guitar riff, punchy drums, tight bass. Ends on a big final power chord with a cymbal crash and a short natural decay.
